profile.headline: Software Engineer II at Microsoft
profile.summary: I am a software engineer with comprehensive experience making customized solutions within Microsoft Dynamics 365 according to business requirements. Created dynamic client-side applications with HTML5, CSS, Javascript, and Bootstrap. Implemented server-side technologies in C#, such as  ASP.NET WEB API, Microsoft SQL Server, and MySQL databases. Made customizations and extensions to the Microsoft Dynamics 365 online platform to meet both client side and server side business requirements from the client.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Engineered multiple Dynamics 365 (D365) case auto-routing systems for internal and federal use, utilizing the Power Platform. This allowed for streamlined case management, optimized resource allocation, improved response times, and guaranteed secure processing of government contracts.
- Customized a D365 Omnichannel implementation that leveraged Power Virtual Agent, empowering collectors to efficiently connect to customers and improve debt collection operations.
- Leveraged OpenAI and Power Automate to create a dynamic list of agent actions, generated from collector agent call summaries, to enhance agent end user productivity.
- Served as a Team Lead for a worldwide development team ensuring seamless collaboration to achieve project milestones and provide around-the-clock support to address critical issues.
- Acted as Engineering primary point of contact for the customer, establishing a strong rapport that instilled confidence and resulted in improved customer satisfaction and increased project success. 
- Contributed to Microsoft's system for COVID-19 vaccine appointments using D365, Power Automate, and Power Apps to create a scheduling platform, contributing to global health efforts during the pandemic.

positions.title: Senior Analyst, D365 CRM Solution Developer
positions.description:
- Was part of the Microsoft Account
- Conducted a Complexity and Engineering Hygiene Assessment of an existing D365 application, including configurations, customizations, integrations, and ADO engineering practices
- Worked as a Software Engineer who built technical solutions to extend the capabilities of Dynamics 365
- Utilized Power Automate capability to make automatic processes and integrations

positions.title: Senior Associate
positions.description:
-Worked as an Assistant Team Lead to train, provide guidance, and review work backlog of reporting team members
-Helped onboard and train novice team members on SOPs and best practices
-Worked as a Techno-Functional Consultant to provide business solutions as well as technical support for Dynamics 365 Online Customers
-Worked as a Support Engineer to mitigate and resolve customer issues effectively and efficiently
-Preview pre-release application functionality for Microsoft and demo for clients for their future application implementations
-Requirement gathering from stakeholders
-Collaborated with Dynamics 365 and Office Developers to identify, mitigate, and resolve D365 and Office Product Bugs
-Developed a custom integration tool to collect Ticket data from external data sources and integrate into the Dynamics 365 Concierge Team's personal Dynamics 365 Environment to enable automated reporting
-Responsible for developing an internal Dynamics 365 Environment to track End of Life software customers and communication

positions.title: .NET/Microsoft Dynamics Developer
positions.description:
- Extensive project development in HTML, CSS, Bootstrap, JavaScript, C#, SQL, and Microsoft Dynamics 365.
- Implemented HTML to structure markup pages and CSS for styling design.
- Leveraged Bootstrap framework and grid system to build responsive web pages.
- Consumed Web API web services via JavaScript and AJAX to enhance web application functionality.
- Utilized C# to implement ASP.NET Web API to communicate with SQL Server.
- Experience with the 3 Microsoft Dynamics 365 Online modules - Sales, Service, Marketing.
- Knowledgeable about requirement gathering process for client's needs of Microsoft Dynamics 365.
- Coded C# workflow extensions for custom functionality on server side.
- Developed JavaScript to extend workflow functionality on client side.
- Created C# custom plug-in extensions utilizing Microsoft Dynamics SDK.
- Collaborated in team environments following Agile practices.

positions.title: Operations Intern
positions.description:
- Assisting with Georgetown University and Simmons College teams with auditing, optimizing, and documenting internal processes in SalesForce for developing best practices
- Research and analysis of US News Rankings to understand competition and market, resulting in better informed business decisions
- Producing Georgetown University’s Annual Operating Plan to communicate advancements and future strategic initiatives to Georgetown partners
